source_section: Antal anbudsgivare och anbud efter företagsstorlek för leverantören, 2024
notes: Supplier-size class is Statistics Sweden's employee-only classification, not EU turnover/balance-sheet classification.
The 71,128 bids with supplier metadata differ from the 74,133 total bids; supplier-personal-data exclusions and missing metadata matter.
Bid-count coverage was available for 58 percent of all advertised 2024 tenders; do not extrapolate to all Swedish tenders.
Publisher's 36-40 percent win-rate range across company-size groups is separate from the table, not calculated from bid-count rows.
These are historic procurement participation counts, not AgentMine buyer demand, paid customers or willingness to pay.
A 2024 all-sector bid-throughput ratio cannot be assumed to hold within CPV48 or CPV72.
